description: (needs account token) Moves a domain that is already on the account to another of its sites, or back onto a site it was split from. Does not buy a name and does not edit DNS at another registrar. confirm=true applies the move. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

domain.description: A domain already on this account.

to_site.description: The address of the site to point it at, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.
